title: console-lab: Vite devDependency bump 8.3.1 → 8.3.3
summary: A single-line dependency bump in the console-lab app: the Vite devDependency moves from 8.3.1 to 8.3.3. Nothing in the app's source, build configuration or runtime wiring changes; the effect is confined to the toolchain that builds and serves the console-lab bundle, so the blast radius is the local dev server and the single-file production build.

nodes.label: vite
nodes.summary: The Vite build tool and dev server, pinned as a devDependency of console-lab. This change bumps the pin from 8.3.1 to 8.3.3; no other dependency or script in the manifest moves.

nodes.label: @vitejs/plugin-react
nodes.summary: React fast-refresh and JSX transform plugin, unchanged at 6.1.2. It runs inside Vite's plugin pipeline, so it is the neighbour most directly exposed to the Vite version.

nodes.label: vite-plugin-singlefile
nodes.summary: Build-only plugin that inlines all assets into one HTML file. Unchanged, but it hooks Vite's build lifecycle and therefore shares the upgraded Vite runtime.

nodes.label: console-lab source

nodes.label: Vite config
nodes.summary: The Vite configuration that registers the React and single-file plugins and defines the build target. Unchanged, but it is where the upgraded Vite version is actually applied.

nodes.label: Dev server
nodes.summary: The local Vite dev server with HMR that serves console-lab during development. Its behaviour comes from the Vite version now pinned at 8.3.3.

nodes.label: Single-file bundle
nodes.summary: The production artifact: one HTML file with scripts and styles inlined by vite-plugin-singlefile, produced by the Vite build.
